day_shape: 71 items: UNSC convenes on Iran non-proliferation with UK demand for IAEA inspector return, tanker fire in Strait of Hormuz after mine strike, Pezeshkian-Putin energy talks in Moscow, Houthi missile claim on Riyadh defence ministry, two charged under UK National Security Act over RAF Fairford.

threads.label: UN Security Council meets on Iran nuclear file
threads.summary: The UN Security Council held a briefing on Iran non-proliferation with IAEA Director General Grossi, following the IAEA Board's referral. UK Ambassador Sarah MacIntosh called for the return of IAEA inspectors to all Iranian nuclear sites; Iran's UN charge d'affaires Dehghani accused Western members of silence and pointed to Israel's nuclear arsenal.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker fire and shipping disputes
threads.summary: Iran's Army Navy said a tanker that had switched off tracking systems struck sea mines and caught fire in the east of the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority threatened legal action against vessels of South Korean company Sinokor. CENTCOM rejected as false an IRGC Navy commander's claim that US forces had abandoned the Strait.

threads.label: Pezeshkian-Putin Moscow energy talks
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian met Putin in Moscow on the sidelines of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum, with the two sides discussing joint oil and gas projects and expanded economic cooperation. Pezeshkian told the GECF summit that US military interventions in the Persian Gulf threatened global energy security.

threads.label: Regional diplomacy around Iran
threads.summary: Qatar urged Iran to show goodwill on mediation after a Tehran visit coordinated with the US; Iraqi FM Fuad Hussein said Baghdad is pursuing a '6+2' meeting between Iran and the GCC. Iran International reported neighbours' diplomacy carries demands including reopening the Strait of Hormuz and unobstructed IAEA access, framed by one analyst as possibly a 'last chance' before military action.

threads.label: Yemen-Saudi exchanges
threads.summary: Yemen's armed forces spokesman Yahya Saree claimed a ballistic missile strike on the Saudi defence ministry in Riyadh and Houthis claimed hits on the Ras Tanura refinery, while Defa Press said Saudi jets conducted 81 strikes across Yemeni governorates. Iran's National Security Council Secretary Bagheri met Yemen's ambassador to review combat fronts.

threads.label: UK and Kuwait Iran-linked prosecutions
threads.summary: Two men appeared in a London court charged under Britain's National Security Act over last month's RAF Fairford incident, with prosecutors alleging one sought to assist Iranian intelligence. A Kuwaiti court sentenced three men to death for collaborating with Iran and Hezbollah in a plot to assassinate Interior Minister Sheikh Fahad Al-Yousef Al-Sabah.

threads.label: Jordan church attack fallout
threads.summary: Jordan carried out airstrikes in southern Syria targeting what it said were hideouts linked to Friday's deadly church attack in Karak, with some Arab commentators circulating claims the attack was an Israeli false-flag. Iran's FM Araghchi phoned his Jordanian counterpart to condemn the attack.

events.summary_en: Meeting of Secretary of Supreme National Security Council with Supreme Leader of Revolution. Emphasis on realising Iran's conditions aimed at ending the war. The Supreme National Security Council is the four-way conduct of state affairs. General Doctor Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, met with Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution. In this meeting, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei referred to the Supreme National Security Council and its secretariat as the "four-way conduct" of state affairs and emphasised the reciprocal influence of four domains: "culture", "politics", "economy" and "security", and the necessity of having appropriate annexes corresponding to decision-making in each domain. The Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution emphasised the need to benefit from a roadmap.
